meta.title: Fix UI flickering in token asset details page
meta.body_summary: Fix UI flickering in token asset details page by optimizing context provider, loading state transitions, and memoization to prevent unnecessary re-renders.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to fix UI flickering but the fix was already applied upstream; PR closed by Devin bot citing prior merged fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 92 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. As a small incremental frontend performance fix, it was closed without merge because the issue was already resolved upstream.

core_change_summary.description: In TokenDetailsHeader.tsx, TokenDetailsHistory.tsx, and index.tsx, introduced optimizations such as memoization, context provider refactoring, and loading state delays to reduce UI flickering.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes confined to the three TokenDetails components.
